en: Go to the Sanctum of the Level.
Go to the ledge above the still basin.
Read the roll of the Cantors.
Kerrid is standing at the outer moorings.
Rest at the High Warden's house. The wedding is at dusk.
Ysolde has a house she hasn't been back to.
One of the Lamplighters can't keep his flame straight.
Records you find are kept in the codex, under Records. Open one to read it again.
A strip from a founder's lamp-ledger, torn across. Only a few words are left on it, and none of them finish.
A reader's copybook from the Lamp Archive, folded in the Ansedra manner. She has written in the margins.
White rooms off a still courtyard. The basin in the middle doesn't move, and nobody speaks above a murmur. The sheets are very clean.
